cases.title: Burglary & Keypad Breach at Greenwood Jewellers
cases.summary: High-value diamond inventory (estimated INR 3.8 Crores) stolen through Service Entry Door 2B without signs of forced entry. Keypad access log records PIN #4819 entered at 21:26. Intruder alarm was deactivated using secondary override switch. Strong contradictions exist between suspect statements, cellular mast records, and CCTV surveillance logs.

FIRST INFORMATION REPORT (Under Section 154 Cr.P.C.)
District: Central Metropolitan | Station: Sector 4 | FIR No: 2025-0842 | Date: 25-Oct-2025
Complainant: Rajiv Bansal, General Manager, Greenwood Jewellers, 44 Market Arcade.
Statement of Complainant:
"On the morning of 25th October 2025 at 06:45 hours, when cleaning staff unlocked the front shutter, the internal vault room door was found ajar. Safe Box #4 containing unmounted loose diamonds and wedding necklaces had been emptied. No exterior doors or windows show physical marks of crowbar or glass cutters. Rear service door 2B electronic lock was disarmed with valid credential entry. The system recorded PIN 4819 at 21:26 hours on 24-Oct-2025. Only two people possessed this emergency PIN: Assistant Manager Rahul Sharma and myself."

contradictions.title: Severe Geographical Impossibility: Green Park Alibi vs Sector 4-B Mast CDR Ping

claimA.evidenceTitle: Sworn Witness Statement of Vikram Malhotra
claimA.excerpt: "From 20:30 hours onwards, Rahul and I were continuously in our living room playing FIFA on PlayStation... Rahul never left the flat even once during the entire evening."

claimB.evidenceTitle: Cellular Tower CDR & Handover Records (Tower Mast SEC-4B)
claimB.location: Sector 4-B Mast Node (within 280m of Market Arcade)
claimB.excerpt: "2025-10-24 21:21:40: Mast SEC-4B (Market Arcade) - SMS delivery ping & data packet (Signal -74dBm, Distance estimate ~280m from Jewellers)."

contradictions.explanation: Sector 9 (Green Park) and Sector 4 (Market Arcade) are separated by 14.8 km of urban arterial roadway with a minimum transit time of 25–35 minutes during evening traffic. Rahul Sharma could not have been physically present in the Sector 9 living room at 21:21 while his handset simultaneously exchanged data packets with a cell mast in Sector 4.
alternativeExplanations: The handset was loaned to, borrowed by, or left in possession of an associate (e.g. Karan Verma or another party).
The roommate Vikram Malhotra is deliberately providing a false alibi or was mistaken regarding exact hours.
Cellular tower handover anomaly or mast redirection (extremely unlikely given clear -74dBm signal strength and subsequent transit handover to Mast SEC-6C).
suggestedVerificationSteps: Obtain CCTV elevator and foyer footage from Green Park Enclave building to verify actual ingress/egress times of Rahul Sharma.
Subpoena Swiggy delivery rider contact notes for the 20:45 food order to establish who opened the door.
Cross-examine Vikram Malhotra regarding exact timestamps and gaming session logs.
contradictions.investigatorNotes: Critical conflict. Swiggy delivery record indicates delivery knocked at 21:10 and no one answered. Roommate statement appears compromised.

contradictions.title: Suspect Location Conflict: Karan Verma Pune Trip Claim vs Sector 3 Toll Plaza ANPR Capture

claimA.evidenceTitle: City Toll Plaza ANPR Camera Log (Plaza Sector 3 Northbound)
claimA.excerpt: "Detected Plate: DL-08-BQ-9102 (Silver Hyundai Verna). Registered to Dinesh Verma (Brother of ex-contractor Karan Verma). Vehicle entered Sector 4 arterial road at 20:45."

claimB.evidenceTitle: Preliminary Suspect Background & Formal Query Response
claimB.excerpt: "Karan Verma stated he had departed for Pune on 22nd October on personal family business and was not present in the National Capital Region on the night of the burglary."

contradictions.explanation: Karan Verma asserts he was over 1,400 km away in Pune. However, the vehicle he customarily operates (registered to his brother Dinesh) was photographed entering the crime scene sector at 20:45:12 and exiting at 21:54:19.
alternativeExplanations: The vehicle was operated solely by Dinesh Verma or an acquaintance, without Karan Verma present.
Cloned license plate (requires ANPR image wheel-rim and damage scratch matching against the actual vehicle).
suggestedVerificationSteps: Demand flight / train / hotel ticketing records from Karan Verma proving Pune presence.
Inspect physical vehicle DL-08-BQ-9102 for forensic fiber/fingerprint matching.
Interview brother Dinesh Verma regarding who possessed the vehicle keys on Oct 24.
contradictions.investigatorNotes: Brother Dinesh has been summoned to produce the vehicle and key registry at Sector 4 police station.

contradictions.title: Eyewitness Timing Discrepancy: Alley Sighting vs Keypad Lock Engagement

claimA.evidenceTitle: Witness Statement of Pooja Nair (Balcony Resident)
claimA.excerpt: "Around 21:15 hours... The person stopped near Door 2B and appeared to manipulate the lock keypad."

claimB.evidenceTitle: Digital Keypad Access Controller Memory Dump (Door 2B)
claimB.excerpt: "2025-10-24 21:26:04 - User: PIN AUTH #4819 - Status: UNLOCKED SUCCESSFUL. No failed PIN attempts recorded prior to 21:26:04."

contradictions.explanation: Witness remembers seeing the person manipulate the keypad around 21:15, yet the electronic lock controller recorded zero activity until the successful entry at 21:26:04. This represents an 11-minute gap.
alternativeExplanations: Normal human time estimation error (witness was talking on phone and estimated 21:15 in retrospect).
The subject was inspecting the lock housing, camera wiring, or waiting in shadow for 10 minutes before inputting the code.
Discrepancy between witness phone clock and lock internal clock (though lock is NTP-synced).
suggestedVerificationSteps: Check phone call records of Pooja Nair to pinpoint exact time she answered the call on her balcony.
Inspect alleyway lighting shadows to determine if subject could have loitered unobserved.
contradictions.investigatorNotes: Likely benign estimation discrepancy or subject spent 10 minutes scoping the alley before committing to enter the code.

gaps.title: Missing CCTV Footage: Alleyway Camera #03 Disconnection Window (21:10 – 21:40)
gaps.description: Market Arcade management camera #03, mounted on pole facing Door 2B, experienced an unrecorded signal blackout starting at 21:10 and returning at 21:41. Physical inspection revealed low-voltage power supply jack was disconnected.
gaps.whyItMatters: Camera #03 would have provided direct facial identification of the person entering Door 2B and clear view of the vehicle license plate.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: Whether the camera was deliberately unplugged by an insider prior to the breach or suffered an accidental failure.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Dust the exterior power transformer box and camera #03 power cable jack for latent fingerprints.

gaps.title: Uncorroborated Alibi: Unanswered Swiggy Delivery at Green Park Apartment
gaps.description: Roommate Vikram claimed he and Rahul were home eating dinner ordered at 20:45. However, preliminary app metadata shows delivery rider arrived at 21:10 and marked order as "Unanswered knock - left on doormat".
gaps.whyItMatters: Directly undermines the physical presence claim of both individuals at the alleged alibi premises between 21:00 and 21:30.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: Whether anyone was actually inside flat 402 at 21:10, or if both individuals had departed earlier.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Formalize statement from Swiggy delivery rider and review Green Park apartment building main gate security register.

gaps.title: Unverified Master Keypad Code Revocation History
gaps.description: Rajiv Bansal claimed only he and Rahul Sharma knew PIN #4819. However, the store security vendor (Apex Guard Systems) has not yet provided the historical provisioning logs.
gaps.whyItMatters: If PIN #4819 was issued to previous managers or contractors (such as Karan Verma) and never changed, an external actor could have known the code without Rahul Sharma’s involvement.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: When PIN #4819 was generated and whether it had ever been provided to third-party vendors or former staff.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Issue formal notice to Apex Guard Systems for complete audit trail of OmniLock keypad programming.

gaps.title: Unidentified Passenger in Silver Sedan DL-08-BQ-9102
gaps.description: Sector 3 Toll camera captured vehicle entering Sector 4 at 20:45. Driver was visible, but front passenger seat was obscured by glare.
gaps.whyItMatters: Could establish whether Karan Verma and Rahul Sharma were traveling together or if another accomplice was involved.
gaps.whatIsUnknown: Identity of passenger in vehicle DL-08-BQ-9102.
gaps.suggestedNextStep: Request secondary angle traffic junction camera feeds from Sector 3 Roundabout (CCTV-J3-02).

assistantMessages.content: What evidence directly contradicts Rahul Sharma’s alibi?

### 1. Direct Answer
There is a documented, high-severity inconsistency between Rahul Sharma’s claimed alibi and objective telecommunications data.

### 2. Relevant Evidence & Cross-Referencing
- **Roommate Statement (EV-002):** Vikram Malhotra states Rahul arrived at their Green Park Enclave residence (Sector 9) at 20:15 and remained continuously inside playing video games until 00:30.
- **Telecom Mast CDR (EV-004):** Bharti Airtel Cell Mast SEC-4B (serving Sector 4 Market Arcade) recorded an active data and SMS ping from Rahul Sharma’s primary handset at **21:21:40 IST** (-74dBm signal strength, ~280m from the crime scene).
- **Physical Feasibility:** Sector 9 and Sector 4 are **14.8 km apart** with an estimated 25 to 35-minute transit duration. An individual cannot be in a Sector 9 apartment at 21:21 while their phone actively communicates with a Sector 4 cell tower.

### 3. Alternative Explanations (Non-Deceptive Alternatives)
- **Device Separation:** The handset could have been carried by a third party, left inside a rideshare, or loaned to an acquaintance.
- **Cell Handover Anomaly:** Although improbable given the strong signal and transit sequence through Sector 6, tower overflow or mast re-routing must be ruled out through operator logs.
- **Roommate Time Estimation Error:** Vikram Malhotra may have misjudged the exact departure or arrival windows.

### 4. Recommended Investigative Verification Steps
1. Subpoena building CCTV footage from Green Park Enclave elevator and gate to verify exact ingress/egress.
2. Interview Swiggy food delivery courier regarding the 21:10 delivery attempt that went unanswered.
3. Request operator network maintenance logs for Mast SEC-4B on Oct 24.
